description.value:
Cast 10 minutes

Requirement You possess a bio-augment.

Your Ward can be scrawled onto a bio-augment instead of carried separately.

You bind your Ward into one bio-augment you carry rather than into an object you hold or wear separately. The augment functions exactly as it did before, and your Ward functions exactly as it did before; the two simply now occupy the same slot on your body instead of two. This doesn't change either's Load, Resonance, or price.
